title: Landlord Retaliation After Reported Code Violation
description: Use this service request to report retaliatory actions by a landlord/Owner after a Code violation was reported, i.e., complaints of decreased or diminished services, access to amenities, increased rent, eviction, etc. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 13 business days.

options: Nuisance (e.g: dumping, graffiti, high weeds, litter, noise)

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for suspected landlord or owner retaliation after a reported code violation, including reduced services or amenity access, increased rent, or eviction.
actions.why: For suspected landlord or owner retaliation after a reported Code violation, including reduced services or amenity access, increased rent, or eviction. The request form asks about the original violation and service request number/date, the alleged retaliation and date, the landlord/property manager or other actor, property type, and details such as an eviction notice or diminished services.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "City Code Violations" > Choose "Landlord Retaliation After Reported Code Violation"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "City Code Violations" > Choose "Landlord Retaliation After Reported Code Violation"
